description: Play the game headlessly with random but plausible input (movement keys held, action keys tapped) to find runtime errors, stuck states and back-and-forth loops. Each finding includes the explained error (kind, source-mapped file:line, hint) and `repro`: a scenario file that replays it exactly. Pass that file to run_scenarios to reproduce, then again after fixing to verify. The same seed gives the same inputs.

keys.description: KeyboardEvent.code values to press. Default: arrows, WASD, Space, Enter, Z, X.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.

seconds.description: Simulated seconds of play per run. Default 60.

seed.description: Input seed; reuse it to repeat a run exactly.

name: fuzz
title: Fuzz playtest
